hotels.vendor_name: Fairmont La Hacienda Costa del Sol
hotels.title: Secluded Southern Spain Championship Golf Retreat with Onsite Dining, Four Pools & Spa
hotels.description: With unbeatable Mediterranean Sea views and lush fairways at its doorstep, this retreat radiates coastal elegance. Minimalist design and organic tones set a calming ambience, leading into the impressive wellness hub Spa Fairmont La Hacienda, featuring two hammams, a relaxing sauna, yoga studio and much more. Set in one of the most privileged enclaves of the Costa del Sol, this exclusive golf resort is home to two world-class courses. Boasting two pools and beach access, it’s easy to find your flow here. Enjoy seasonal Spanish fare at El Faro la Hacienda, savour elevated local flavours at the candlelit Dalmar or unwind at Umbra with cocktails under the Spanish sun.
